user.title: Add a YouTube TV
user.description: Choose how to link this TV.

tv_code.title: Enter the YouTube TV code
tv_code.description: On the TV you want to link, open the YouTube app, go to **Settings → Link with TV code**, and enter the 12-digit code shown on the TV.

existing_screen_id.title: Enter an existing screen ID
existing_screen_id.description: Copy this TV's `screen_id` from the `devices` list in your iSponsorBlockTV `config.json`. You can also copy the TV's `name`.

screen_id_rejected.title: Screen ID rejected
screen_id_rejected.description: YouTube rejected this screen ID. Get a fresh TV code from the YouTube app, or try another saved screen ID.

discovery_confirm.title: Discovered a YouTube TV
discovery_confirm.description: Home Assistant found **{name}** on your network. Continue to check its YouTube pairing.

confirm.title: Confirm the matched TV
confirm.description: The YouTube pairing check succeeded. Submit to add **{name}**.

name.title: Name the matched TV
name.description: YouTube verified the pairing. Enter a name for this TV.

repair_confirm.title: Confirm the original TV
repair_confirm.description: The new code matched a different screen ID. Confirm that you got this code from the same TV you added as **{name}**.

data.same_tv: I got this code from the original TV

error.cannot_connect: YouTube could not verify the pairing right now. Try again.
error.invalid_code: The TV code is invalid or expired. Enter the current 12-digit code shown on the TV.
error.name_required: Enter a name for this TV.
error.confirm_original_tv: Confirm the code came from the original TV to continue.

abort.no_youtube_screen: The TV did not expose a YouTube screen ID. You can add it with a TV code.

data_description.skip_categories: Clear all categories to disable SponsorBlock skipping on this TV.
data_description.offset: Use a positive value to send the seek command earlier.
data_description.disturb_short_videos: Interrupt all videos shorter than the threshold, including regular videos. Also send Back after reconnecting from a recent TV-initiated user disconnect.
data_description.short_video_duration_threshold: Compare this threshold with the duration reported by the YouTube app.
data_description.channel_settings: Choose a channel settings menu and submit. Save playback changes separately.

data.join_name: Name shown in the YouTube app
data.channel_whitelist: Channels to exclude from SponsorBlock skipping

data_description.channel_whitelist: Enter the YouTube channel ID for each channel you want to exclude. Set the YouTube Data API key in Global channel settings.

menu_options.tv_blocklist_mode: Choose which blocklist this TV uses

global_channels.title: Global channel settings
global_channels.description: The API key is shared by all TVs. Each TV uses the global blocklist by default.

menu_options.global_api_key: Set or clear the shared YouTube Data API key

tv_blocklist_mode.title: Choose this TV's blocklist
tv_blocklist_mode.description: Turn this on to use this TV's own blocklist in place of the global list. An empty override allows all channels. Turning it off returns to the global list.

global_api_key.title: Shared YouTube Data API key
global_api_key.description:
Shared key {key_status}

Enter a key to replace it. Clearing it disables channel searches and playback checks for all TVs.

tv_blocklist.title: Blocklist for this TV
tv_blocklist.description: Saved channels {count}. This list takes effect when the TV is set to use its own blocklist. A shared API key is required to check channels during playback.

menu_options.channel_search: Search for a channel by name

global_blocklist.title: Global channel blocklist
global_blocklist.description: Saved channels {count}. This list applies to TVs that use the global blocklist. A shared API key is required to check channels during playback.

menu_options.channel_search: Search for a channel by name

channel_select.title: Choose the channel to block
channel_select.description: Check the name and description before saving the channel ID.

channel_add_id.title: Add a YouTube channel ID
channel_add_id.description: Enter the 24-character ID starting with UC. You can find it after `/channel/` in the channel's ID-based URL.

error.api_key_required: Set the shared YouTube Data API key before changing which channels are excluded from SponsorBlock.
error.api_key_rejected: YouTube rejected the request. Check the shared key, whether the YouTube Data API is enabled, and its quota.
error.api_key_required_for_channel_search: Set the shared YouTube Data API key in Global channel settings to search by name.
error.channel_already_blocked: This channel is already saved in this blocklist.
error.channel_lookup_failed: YouTube channel data is unavailable. Try again.
error.channel_search_failed: YouTube channel search is unavailable. Check the shared key and search quota, then try again.
error.channel_settings_save_failed: Home Assistant could not save the global channel settings. Try again.
error.invalid_channel_id: Enter a valid YouTube channel ID starting with UC.
error.invalid_short_video_duration_threshold: Enter a finite duration in seconds.
error.invalid_sponsorblock_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL for the SponsorBlock API.
error.legacy_api_key_conflict: Existing TVs use different API keys. Enter the key all TVs should share.
error.provide_key_or_clear: Enter a new key or choose to clear it.
error.select_channel_to_remove: Select at least one channel to remove.
